9: Benjamin Hou, Yann Thanwerdas, Stefan Heyder, Olivier Peltre, Niklas Koep, Hadi Zaatiti,
10: Hatem Hajri, Yann Cabanes, Thomas Gerald, Paul Chauchat, Christian Shewmake, Daniel Brooks,
11: Bernhard Kainz, Claire Donnat, Susan Holmes and Xavier Pennec.
12: Geomstats:  A Python Package for Riemannian Geometry in Machine Learning,
13: Journal of Machine Learning Research, 2020, volume 21, number 223, pages 1-9,
14: http://jmlr.org/papers/v21/19-027.html, https://github.com/geomstats/geomstats/
15: """
16: 
17: import numpy as _np
18: from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist, pdist
19: from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import euclidean_distances, pairwise_distances
20: 
21: 
22: class NumPyBackend(object):
23:     """Class for the Numpy  backend."""
24: 
25:     def __init__(self):
26:         self.backend_string = "numpy"
27: 
28:         self.linalg = NumPyLinalg()
29:         self.random = NumPyRandom()
30:         self.testing = NumPyTesting()
31: 
32:         self.int8 = _np.int8
33:         self.int16 = _np.int16
34:         self.int32 = _np.int32
35:         self.int64 = _np.int64
36:         self.float32 = _np.float32
37:         self.float64 = _np.float64
38:         self.complex64 = _np.complex64
39:         self.complex128 = _np.complex128
40: 
41:         self.abs = _np.abs
42:         self.all = _np.all
43:         self.any = _np.any
44:         self.arange = _np.arange
45:         self.argmax = _np.argmax
46:         self.argmin = _np.argmin
47:         self.array = _np.array
48:         self.asarray = _np.asarray
49:         self.cdist = cdist
50:         self.ceil = _np.ceil
51:         self.dbl_max = _np.finfo("double").max
52:         self.diag = _np.diag
53:         self.empty = _np.empty
54:         self.exp = _np.exp
55:         self.eye = _np.eye
56:         self.floor = _np.floor
57:         self.full = _np.full
58:         self.hstack = _np.hstack
59:         self.inf = _np.inf
60:         self.iscomplex = _np.iscomplex
61:         self.isfinite = _np.isfinite
62:         self.isnan = _np.isnan
63:         self.log = _np.log
64:         self.max = _np.max
65:         self.mean = _np.mean
66:         self.median = _np.median
67:         self.min = _np.min
68:         self.nan = _np.nan
69:         self.pairwise_distances = pairwise_distances
70:         self.pairwise_euclidean_distances = euclidean_distances
71:         self.pdist = pdist
72:         self.reshape = _np.reshape
73:         self.round = _np.round
74:         self.shape = _np.shape
75:         self.sqrt = _np.sqrt
76:         self.sum = _np.sum
77:         self.tril = _np.tril
78:         self.tril_indices = _np.tril_indices
79:         self.triu = _np.triu
80:         self.triu_indices = _np.triu_indices
81:         self.vstack = _np.vstack
82:         self.zeros = _np.zeros
83:         self.zeros_like = _np.zeros_like
84: 
85:     @staticmethod
86:     def belongs_to_backend(x):
87:         return "numpy" in str(type(x)).lower()
88: 
89:     @staticmethod
90:     def cast(x, dtype):
91:         return x.astype(dtype)
92: 
93:     @staticmethod
94:     def copy(x):
95:         return x.copy()
96: 
97:     @staticmethod
98:     def from_numpy(x):
99:         return x
100: 
101:     @staticmethod
102:     def is_array(x):
103:         return type(x) is _np.ndarray
104: 
105:     @staticmethod
106:     def is_float(x):
107:         return isinstance(x, (_np.floating, float))
108: 
109:     @staticmethod
110:     def is_float32(x):
111:         return isinstance(x, _np.float32)
112: 
113:     @staticmethod
114:     def is_float64(x):
115:         return isinstance(x, _np.float64)
116: 
117:     @staticmethod
118:     def ndim(x):
119:         return x.ndim
120: 
121:     @staticmethod
122:     def to_numpy(x):
123:         return x
124: 
125: 
126: class NumPyLinalg:
127:     def __init__(self):
128:         self.inv = _np.linalg.inv
129:         self.norm = _np.linalg.norm
130: 
131: 
132: class NumPyRandom:
133:     def __init__(self):
134:         self.rand = _np.random.rand
135:         self.randint = _np.random.randint
136:         self.randn = _np.random.randn
137: 
138: 
139: class NumPyTesting:
140:     def __init__(self):
141:         self.assert_allclose = _np.testing.assert_allclose
142:         self.assert_equal = _np.testing.assert_equal
